summary: Read a list of integers. The same value may appear more than once. Write every subset that is different from the others. A subset is made by choosing some positions from the input, and one position cannot be chosen twice, so a value may be chosen only as many times as it appears. When two choices produce the same values with the same counts, keep a single copy. Write the empty subset as well. Inside each subset, keep the relative order those values had in the input. Negative numbers and zero may appear in the input.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
